input_equivalence.basis: Only 47 parameter-help strings in the reviewed public core tool server change. Tool names, schemas apart from those descriptions, handlers, validation, permissions and cancellation behavior are unchanged. All dependencies, workflows, licences, notices, model assets, vendor provenance and six prior resolved inventories remain byte-identical. No new resolution, advisory scan or installed qualification.

qualification.scope: Bounded description compaction preserving intended 76-tool surface and the original strict 62000-byte tool-array budget. No model-quality, full safety suite, native Windows or installed/live qualification.
qualification.source_integrity: Exactly one reviewed public source path and canonical manifest/binding change. All 2497 source files remain inventoried. Dependency/model/licence/notice/vendor/workflow files and six SBOMs are unchanged.
qualification.behavior: 47 before/after description pairs independently reviewed for every instructional fact, including required confirmation and workbench fallback title. All other AST and converted schema structure remains identical.
qualification.checks: 18 focused tests pass; independent negative controls reject bloat, added/removed tools, missing contacts/daily_briefing, strictness loss and legacy Gmail. SDK MockTransport confirms actual tools-array serialization without network calls.
qualification.budget: 76 tools serialize to 61977 UTF-8 bytes under unchanged strict <62000 cap; 23 bytes margin. Bound excludes HTTP envelope and is not a tokenizer budget.
qualification.integration_limit: Private count fixture and Windows Safety runtime composition routing are required separately. Do not copy public runtime into private shadows.
